Uncategorised

About Helix

TA
Tracy Admin 15 June 2026 · 1 min read

// about

We were tired of being woken up at 3am

Helix is built by on-call engineers for on-call engineers.

(01)

Our story

EST. 2022

Helix started at 3 a.m. during an incident nobody could explain. Three dashboards, two log tools and a tracing system that never agreed — and a checkout outage burning revenue by the minute.

We were tired of stitching context together by hand while customers waited. So we built the tool we wished we’d had: one pipeline where logs, metrics and traces share a schema, a timeline and a query language.

Observability shouldn’t require a second mortgage or a PhD. It should just answer the question.
HELIX · PRODUCTION METRICS LIVE
<400ms p95 query latency at 10B events
99.99% ingestion uptime SLA
4,000+ engineering teams onboard
62% lower cost vs. legacy APM
(02) / THE JOURNEY

How we got here

2022

The 3 a.m. idea

Two on-call engineers sketch a unified telemetry pipeline on a whiteboard.

2023

First 100 teams

Helix ships logs and metrics; early adopters cut MTTR in half.

2024

SOC 2 & enterprise

SAML, SCIM and audit logs land; the first enterprise rollouts begin.

2025

Tail-based sampling

Traces join the platform with sampling that keeps what matters.

2026

4,000+ teams

Helix becomes the default observability stack for fast-moving teams.

(03) / WHAT WE BELIEVE

Our values

Speed is a feature

If an answer takes minutes to load, it's already too late.

One source of truth

Logs, metrics and traces belong on one timeline, not three tabs.

Honest pricing

You pay for what you query, not for data you'll never read.

Secure by default

SSO, audit logs and field-level redaction ship on day one.
